text: ゴミばこに　へんな　きのみが　すてて　あったけど　なんだろう？

structure.jp: へんな　きのみが　すてて　あったけど
structure.en: a strange Berry had been thrown away, but

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: ある after a て-form says something is sitting in the state someone left it in. すてて　あった = 'had been thrown away and was lying there'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう after a question word means the speaker is wondering to himself. なんだろう = 'I wonder what it is'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど here does not really mean 'but'; it just sets the scene before the question. あったけど = 'there was one, and...'.
